sentences.text:
2. Administrator Tehsildar Reodar, Gramdani Gra
 Tokra Tehsil Roedar Dist. Sirohi

For Petitioner(s) : Mr. B.S. Deora
 For Respondent(s) : Mr. Vikram Sharma, P
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Manoj Kumar Garg
Order 21/04/2023 Heard.
Issue notice.
Learned Public Prosecutor accepts notices on behalf of respondent No.1-State.
Issue notice to the respondent No.2. Rule is made returnable in the month of July.

In the meanwhile and till next date of hearing, petitioner shall not be arrested in FIR No.34/2023,
Police Station Anadara, District Sirohi for offences under Sections 166A, 420, 467, 468 and 471 of IPC.
However, they shall join the investigation.

(MANOJ KUMAR GARG),J 35-Rashi/-
